meanings.en: behaving in a polite or proper way
meanings.exampleEn: The teacher praised the well-behaved students.
meanings.exampleTr: Öğretmen uslu öğrencileri övdü.

meanings.en: connected with the sea or shipping
meanings.exampleEn: The country has a long maritime history.
meanings.exampleTr: Ülkenin uzun bir denizcilik tarihi var.

meanings.en: connected with ships, sailing or sailors
meanings.exampleEn: He used nautical terms when describing the voyage.
meanings.exampleTr: Yolculuğu anlatırken denizcilik terimleri kullandı.

meanings.en: the act of guiding or steering a ship or aircraft
meanings.exampleEn: Piloting a plane in a storm requires great skill.
meanings.exampleTr: Fırtınada uçak kullanmak büyük beceri gerektirir.

meanings.en: the controlling of the direction of a vehicle
meanings.exampleEn: The car's steering felt heavy at low speeds.
meanings.exampleTr: Arabanın direksiyonu düşük hızlarda ağır geliyordu.

meanings.en: in a way that cannot be avoided
meanings.exampleEn: Inevitably, prices rose after the new tax.
meanings.exampleTr: Kaçınılmaz olarak, yeni vergiden sonra fiyatlar yükseldi.

meanings.en: in a way that cannot be prevented
meanings.exampleEn: She was unavoidably delayed by the heavy traffic.
meanings.exampleTr: Yoğun trafik yüzünden kaçınılmaz olarak gecikti.

meanings.en: without money, food or a home
meanings.exampleEn: The war left thousands of families destitute.
meanings.exampleTr: Savaş binlerce aileyi yoksul bıraktı.

meanings.en: having a lot of money and a good standard of living
meanings.exampleEn: They live in an affluent neighbourhood.
meanings.exampleTr: Varlıklı bir mahallede yaşıyorlar.

meanings.en: a mental condition marked by excessive worry and fear
meanings.exampleEn: She was diagnosed with an anxiety disorder last year.
meanings.exampleTr: Geçen yıl ona kaygı bozukluğu teşhisi kondu.

meanings.en: a frightening or unpleasant dream
meanings.exampleEn: The child woke up crying after a bad dream.
meanings.exampleTr: Çocuk kötü bir rüyanın ardından ağlayarak uyandı.

meanings.en: a very unpleasant and difficult experience
meanings.exampleEn: Surviving the shipwreck was a terrible ordeal.
meanings.exampleTr: Gemi kazasından kurtulmak korkunç bir çileydi.

meanings.en: not honest or fair; morally low
meanings.exampleEn: He was driven by ignoble motives of greed.
meanings.exampleTr: Açgözlülüğün alçak güdüleriyle hareket ediyordu.

meanings.en: a member of the highest social class
meanings.exampleEn: The aristocrat owned several large estates.
meanings.exampleTr: Aristokratın birkaç büyük malikânesi vardı.

meanings.en: a person who is not a member of the nobility
meanings.exampleEn: The prince surprised everyone by marrying a commoner.
meanings.exampleTr: Prens, halktan biriyle evlenerek herkesi şaşırttı.

meanings.en: a person who travels from place to place without a fixed home
meanings.exampleEn: He lived as a wanderer, never staying long in one town.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir gezgin gibi yaşadı, hiçbir kasabada uzun süre kalmadı.

meanings.en: a person who moves from place to place with no purpose
meanings.exampleEn: The stranger turned out to be a drifter with no fixed job.
meanings.exampleTr: Yabancının sabit işi olmayan bir avare olduğu ortaya çıktı.

meanings.en: a person who competes for something
meanings.exampleEn: She is a serious contender for the championship.
meanings.exampleTr: Şampiyonluk için ciddi bir aday.

meanings.en: where smoking is not allowed
meanings.exampleEn: The restaurant is a smoke-free environment.
meanings.exampleTr: Restoran sigara içilmeyen bir ortamdır.

meanings.en: the number 0; nothing
meanings.exampleEn: The temperature dropped below zero last night.
meanings.exampleTr: Dün gece sıcaklık sıfırın altına düştü.

meanings.en: nothing or zero, especially in scores
meanings.exampleEn: The home team won three nil.
meanings.exampleTr: Ev sahibi takım üç sıfır kazandı.

meanings.en: food and drink that keep a person alive
meanings.exampleEn: They could barely find enough sustenance to survive the winter.
meanings.exampleTr: Kışı atlatacak kadar besini zar zor bulabildiler.

meanings.en: the quality of being fresh and new
meanings.exampleEn: The freshness of the bread filled the kitchen.
meanings.exampleTr: Ekmeğin tazeliği mutfağı sardı.

meanings.en: good knowledge of something through experience
meanings.exampleEn: Her familiarity with the software made the job easy.
meanings.exampleTr: Yazılıma olan aşinalığı işi kolaylaştırdı.

meanings.en: relating to or expressed in numbers
meanings.exampleEn: Enter the code using the numeric keypad.
meanings.exampleTr: Kodu sayısal tuş takımıyla girin.

meanings.en: care for young children during the working day
meanings.exampleEn: They put their son in daycare while they work.
meanings.exampleTr: Çalışırken oğullarını kreşe veriyorlar.

meanings.en: the act of accepting the control of another
meanings.exampleEn: The rebels were forced into submission.
meanings.exampleTr: İsyancılar boyun eğmeye zorlandı.

meanings.en: failure or refusal to obey
meanings.exampleEn: His disobedience angered the strict teacher.
meanings.exampleTr: İtaatsizliği katı öğretmeni kızdırdı.

meanings.en: open refusal to obey someone or something
meanings.exampleEn: She raised her chin in defiance of the order.
meanings.exampleTr: Emre karşı gelerek çenesini kaldırdı.

meanings.en: doing everything that you are expected to do
meanings.exampleEn: He was a dutiful son who cared for his parents.
meanings.exampleTr: Ailesine bakan, görevine bağlı bir evlattı.

meanings.en: openly refusing to obey
meanings.exampleEn: The defiant teenager refused to apologise.
meanings.exampleTr: Meydan okuyan genç özür dilemeyi reddetti.

meanings.en: a public announcement that someone has died
meanings.exampleEn: She read his name in the death notice in the newspaper.
meanings.exampleTr: Gazetedeki ölüm ilanında onun adını okudu.

meanings.en: a person who watches something closely
meanings.exampleEn: He is a keen bird watcher.
meanings.exampleTr: O, hevesli bir kuş gözlemcisidir.

meanings.en: to think about something too much and be unable to stop
meanings.exampleEn: Try not to fixate on your mistakes.
meanings.exampleTr: Hatalarına saplanıp kalmamaya çalış.

meanings.en: an extremely strong interest in something
meanings.exampleEn: He has a strange fixation with old clocks.
meanings.exampleTr: Eski saatlere karşı tuhaf bir saplantısı var.

meanings.en: the state of thinking about something constantly
meanings.exampleEn: Her preoccupation with work left no time for friends.
meanings.exampleTr: İşe olan dalgınlığı arkadaşlarına vakit bırakmadı.

meanings.en: unable to stop doing something even if it is harmful
meanings.exampleEn: He is a compulsive gambler.
meanings.exampleTr: O, kendini tutamayan bir kumarbazdır.

meanings.en: thinking about one thing all the time
meanings.exampleEn: She is fixated on becoming a famous singer.
meanings.exampleTr: Ünlü bir şarkıcı olmaya saplanmış durumda.

meanings.en: done without preparation or planning
meanings.exampleEn: They gave an impromptu performance in the park.
meanings.exampleTr: Parkta doğaçlama bir gösteri yaptılar.

meanings.en: in a natural way without being planned
meanings.exampleEn: The crowd spontaneously began to cheer.
meanings.exampleTr: Kalabalık kendiliğinden tezahürata başladı.

meanings.en: towards the sea
meanings.exampleEn: The boat drifted seaward with the tide.
meanings.exampleTr: Tekne gelgitle denize doğru sürüklendi.

meanings.en: on or towards the land rather than the sea
meanings.exampleEn: A strong onshore wind pushed the waves onto the beach.
meanings.exampleTr: Güçlü bir karasal rüzgâr dalgaları sahile itti.

meanings.en: an oily substance that soothes the skin or feelings
meanings.exampleEn: The cool breeze was a balm after the hot day.
meanings.exampleTr: Serin esinti, sıcak günün ardından bir merhem gibiydi.

meanings.en: a person skilled in the technical details of a job
meanings.exampleEn: A technician came to repair the broken machine.
meanings.exampleTr: Bozuk makineyi tamir etmeye bir teknisyen geldi.

meanings.en: the feeling of expecting good things to happen
meanings.exampleEn: There was a sense of hopefulness in her voice.
meanings.exampleTr: Sesinde bir umutluluk vardı.

meanings.en: the quality of being optimistic and confident
meanings.exampleEn: Her positivity inspired the whole team.
meanings.exampleTr: Pozitifliği tüm takıma ilham verdi.

meanings.en: the tendency to expect the worst
meanings.exampleEn: His pessimism made it hard to plan anything together.
meanings.exampleTr: Karamsarlığı birlikte bir şey planlamayı zorlaştırdı.

meanings.en: a person who focuses on good outcomes
meanings.exampleEn: As a positive thinker, she always finds a way forward.
meanings.exampleTr: Olumlu düşünen biri olarak her zaman bir çıkış yolu bulur.

meanings.en: a person skilled in effective or persuasive speaking
meanings.exampleEn: The senator was a gifted rhetorician who swayed the crowd.
meanings.exampleTr: Senatör, kalabalığı etkileyen yetenekli bir hatipti.

meanings.en: relating to or resembling a symphony
meanings.exampleEn: The film featured a grand symphonic score.
meanings.exampleTr: Film, görkemli bir senfonik müziğe sahipti.

meanings.en: a person who organises the parts of an activity
meanings.exampleEn: The event coordinator arranged every detail of the conference.
meanings.exampleTr: Etkinlik koordinatörü, konferansın her ayrıntısını düzenledi.

meanings.en: a person or book used for planning and organising
meanings.exampleEn: She wrote her appointments in a weekly planner.
meanings.exampleTr: Randevularını haftalık bir ajandaya yazdı.

meanings.en: the quality of following accepted customs and standards
meanings.exampleEn: He rejected the conventionality of his parents' lifestyle.
meanings.exampleTr: Ailesinin yaşam tarzının alışılmışlığını reddetti.

meanings.en: at the beginning, before something changes
meanings.exampleEn: At first I didn't like the city, but now I love it.
meanings.exampleTr: İlk başta şehri sevmemiştim ama şimdi bayılıyorum.

meanings.en: a widespread occurrence of a disease in a community
meanings.exampleEn: The flu epidemic spread quickly through the town.
meanings.exampleTr: Grip salgını kasabaya hızla yayıldı.

meanings.en: to run faster or further than someone
meanings.exampleEn: The fox managed to outrun the hunting dogs.
meanings.exampleTr: Tilki, av köpeklerini koşarak geride bırakmayı başardı.

meanings.en: to go or grow faster than someone or something
meanings.exampleEn: Demand began to outpace supply within weeks.
meanings.exampleTr: Talep birkaç hafta içinde arzı geçmeye başladı.

meanings.en: a group of musicians or performers who work together
meanings.exampleEn: The jazz ensemble played all evening.
meanings.exampleTr: Caz topluluğu bütün akşam çaldı.

meanings.en: to express a strong emotion freely
meanings.exampleEn: She needed to vent her frustration to a friend.
meanings.exampleTr: Hayal kırıklığını bir arkadaşına içini dökerek anlatması gerekiyordu.

meanings.en: a patient who stays in hospital while being treated
meanings.exampleEn: He was admitted as an inpatient after the operation.
meanings.exampleTr: Ameliyattan sonra yatan hasta olarak kabul edildi.

meanings.en: anger caused by something unfair or wrong
meanings.exampleEn: She was filled with indignation at the unfair decision.
meanings.exampleTr: Haksız karar karşısında öfkeyle doldu.

meanings.en: shocking and morally unacceptable
meanings.exampleEn: The newspaper printed scandalous claims about the actor.
meanings.exampleTr: Gazete, oyuncu hakkında skandal iddialar yayımladı.

meanings.en: the blocking of light from one body by another, as the sun or moon
meanings.exampleEn: We watched the solar eclipse through special glasses.
meanings.exampleTr: Güneş tutulmasını özel gözlüklerle izledik.

meanings.en: a person within a group who has special knowledge
meanings.exampleEn: Only an insider could have known those details.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu ayrıntıları yalnızca içeriden biri bilebilirdi.

meanings.en: the residential areas on the edge of a city
meanings.exampleEn: They moved to the suburbs for more space.
meanings.exampleTr: Daha fazla yer için banliyöye taşındılar.

meanings.en: in your mind, without showing it
meanings.exampleEn: He smiled politely but inwardly he was furious.
meanings.exampleTr: Kibarca gülümsedi ama içten içe çok öfkeliydi.

meanings.en: shaped like an ellipse; oval
meanings.exampleEn: The planet follows an elliptical orbit around the sun.
meanings.exampleTr: Gezegen, güneşin etrafında eliptik bir yörünge izler.

meanings.en: shaped like an egg; oval
meanings.exampleEn: The stadium has an egg-shaped design.
meanings.exampleTr: Stadyumun yumurta biçiminde bir tasarımı var.

meanings.en: a warm outer coat, or a final layer of paint
meanings.exampleEn: He put on his topcoat before going out into the cold.
meanings.exampleTr: Soğuğa çıkmadan önce paltosunu giydi.

meanings.en: to give too little importance to something
meanings.exampleEn: The report tends to underemphasize the risks involved.
meanings.exampleTr: Rapor, söz konusu riskleri yeterince vurgulamama eğiliminde.
